title: Tap into your experiment.
takeaway: A running experiment can feed both an agent and a live view.
proof: Background PTC writes a rolling window; another question reads it while it runs; a simulation uses the same stream path.
limits: Sensor replay and numerical simulation. Memory window is 18 rows; snapshots are versioned; task stops on completion.
hardest: Keep stream/task clocks consistent and separate a one-time answer from changing dashboard values.

copy.text: Tap the signal once. Keep its recent context.
One stream. An agent and a dashboard.
Instruments and simulations, connected to the same work.
